None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 01.10.1991 passed by Sessions Judge, Shahjahanpur.

The Third Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shahjahanpur vide order dated 07.07.1990 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo one year rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 5000/- under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Third Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shahjahanpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Thereagainst, revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 52 of 1990 and Appellate Court while dismissing appeal confirmed order of conviction passed by Trial Court but reduced the sentence from one year to six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.
1000/-.
Being aggrieved the revisionist preferred present revision.
